title: ORIGINAL HISENSE ERF6B80HL REMOTE CONTROL FCC ID: 2AVIGBR0018
categoryName: Consumer Electronics:TV, Video & Home Audio:TV, Video & Audio Accessories:Remote Controls
descriptionText: The Original Hisense ERF6B80HL Remote Control is a black, wireless unit designed specifically for Hisense TV models. With a wireless range of 5-10 meters, this remote control is perfect for controlling your TV from a distance. Made in China, this remote is compatible with Hisense TVs and offers convenient control features for your entertainment needs.
